name: Cables Unlimited - Custom Cable Manufacturing
old_description: Cables Unlimited is a manufacturer of custom cable assemblies, custom wire harnesses, fiber cables, and custom hybrid cables to meet even the most unique challenges of the communications, automotive, military, robotic, industrial, wireless, and medical industries.
about:
Cables Unlimited operates from Yaphank, New York, as a division of RF Industries, which acquired the company in June 2011. The business traces its roots to more than three decades of experience in custom cable manufacturing, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. No individual founders are named in available materials.

The company designs and manufactures custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, fiber optic cables, and hybrid cables. Its capabilities span custom cable design, rapid in-house prototyping, and low‑, medium‑, or high‑volume production. The facility also provides installation services through certified technicians, and the firm emphasizes fast turnaround and low minimum order quantities.

Cables Unlimited serves wireless and telecom carriers upgrading to 5G and LTE, military and aerospace programs requiring mil‑spec and tactical cables, robotics applications needing high‑flex solutions, computer/data/communications networks including Cat 5/5e/6 and fiber, medical equipment manufacturers, industrial OEMs, and enterprise customers. The company also works with transportation and automotive sectors.

The company differentiates itself through its Corning Gold Cable Assembly House status, which enables a 25‑year extended warranty on select fiber products, and through compliance with AS9100D, ISO 9001:2015, UL Recognized, RoHS, IPC/WHMA‑A‑620, and ITAR. It also highlights round‑the‑clock engineering support to meet tight deadlines.
